scripts.plugin:validate: npm run build && openclaw plugins validate --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:build: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --entry ./dist/index.js && node -e "const f='openclaw.plugin.json',fs=require('fs'),m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f));m.configContracts={secretInputs:{paths:[{path:'password',expected:'string'}]}};fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(m,null,2)+'\n')"
